name: Artistic Confections

reviewSamples.author: Erika
reviewSamples.text: Perfect experience! She listened, made suggestions, had affordable payment plans, and the taste was great. Not one slice was left.

reviewSamples.author: Mitzi
reviewSamples.text: Made us the most delicious and beautiful vegan wedding cake.

reviewSamples.author: Rachel
reviewSamples.text: A true professional - great flavor and reasonable prices. Best Cake Ever!

reviewSamples.author: Caitlin
reviewSamples.text: I have a gluten allergy and the whole cake was made gluten free - guests couldn't tell the difference.

reviewSamples.author: Cindy
reviewSamples.text: Looked exactly like the photo we provided and was delicious!

notes: No Instagram/Facebook/own website found (confirmed via WeddingWire profile, which shows no website/IG/FB link, and domain search for artisticconfections*.com). Owner: Maria Streety. Real images (10) sourced from the business's WeddingWire vendor gallery (cdn0.weddingwire.com). Starting prices ($4.95/slice buttercream, $6/slice fondant, $2.50/cupcake) come from the WeddingWire FAQ pricing section.
